description:
Fetch a filing document's content from storage.

For one section of a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 20-F (MD&A, Risk Factors, Legal
Proceedings, Item 2.02…), use get_filing_item instead: it returns just
that Item, a fraction of the document, with a link highlighting it.

Returns the document as markdown (default) or raw HTML. Use this to read
the actual text of a whole 10-K, 8-K, exhibit, or any other filing document.
The first line gives its source: the beatandraise.com viewer link, to cite.

Name the document either by accession_number + filename, or by url: a
sec.gov document link (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<cik>/<accession>/<file>,
also inside an /ix?doc= link) or a beatandraise.com document link.

Args:
    accession_number: SEC accession number
    filename: Document filename from the content_object (e.g. "ef20060722_8k.htm")
    cik: Optional. CIK of the filer (e.g. "0000320193"); found from the accession number when left out
    url: Optional. A sec.gov or beatandraise.com link to the document, instead of the fields above (not a company website)
    get_markdown: Return markdown version (default True). Set False for raw HTML.
name: get_document
title: Get Filing Document
